statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-71211 is an SSRF in MLflow AI Gateway: CreateGatewaySecret stores auth_config.api_base without validating host or IP range, and the gateway raw_proxy endpoint forwards requests to that destination. Exploitation requires an authenticated user who can create gateway secrets. No upstream patched mlflow release is available yet (latest tag v3.15.2). Monitoring https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow for a fix.
